confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on aggregator and guide-site figures (Crete Direct, Expatistan, combien-coute.net, Numbeo-style national averages), not official price surveys. Chania is a tourist-heavy market, so July prices may sit above Crete-wide averages. The cocktail anchor uses an Expatistan average of about EUR 9 (flagged by the source as unreliable) and a roughly 2x beer relationship. The wine glass uses a EUR 5-8 guide listing and a hotel bar menu. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on any searched listing or live booking page. The FX value (0.6720 USD per AUD, 4pm 18 Nov 2026; no 19 Nov figure was yet published) came from search-result summaries of the RBA overview page and was not read from the F11.1 table. EUR-to-USD conversions use a cross-rate of about 1.10, derived from that figure and a secondary AUD/EUR quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Crete-wide restaurant and drink benchmarks and the Heraklion budget-guide dinner-for-two figure, adjusted upward for Chania's old-town and harbour tourist pricing. Accommodation is benchmarked to mid-sized Greek island tourist towns in July peak season, without any searched listings.
